definitions.full: H1616. ger גֵּר noun masculine Exod 12:48 sojourner (Arabic , Ethiopic Aramaic , גִּיּוֺר , prostelyte , גַּיֵּר proselytize , Phoenician גר in proper name, & plural גרם ) — גֵּר Gen 15:16 74t.; suffix גֵּרְךָ Exod 20:10 4 t., גֵּרוֺ Deut 1:16 ; plural גֵּרִים Exod 22:20 9 t., גֵּירִים 2Chr 2:16 ; — 1 sojourner , temporary dweller, new-comer (no inherited rights), compare Exod 12:19 ; Lev 24:16 ; Num 15:30 ; Josh 8:33 (opposed to homeborn ); of Abraham at Hebron Gen 23:4 (P; || תּוֺשָׁב ); Moses in desert Exod 2:22 (J) 18:3 (E; here explanation of name Gershom, Moses' son); as claiming hospitality Job 31:32 ; perhaps in above cases, and certainly in General, with technical sense; figurative of Yahweh Jer 14:8 ; of Israel in Egypt Gen 15:13 ; Exod 22:20 ; 23:9 (all J E) Lev 19:34 (H) Deut 10:19 ; 23:8 ; גֵּרִים with Yahweh Lev 25:23 (H) 1Chr 29:15 ; Psa 39:13 (in all || תּוֺשָׁב ) compare 119:19 . 2 usually of גֵּרים in Israel 2Sam 1:13 (Amalekite) compare Josh 8:33 , 35 (E) 20:9 (P) Isa 14:1 ; dwellers in Israel with certain conceded, not inherited right (compare RS OTJC 434; 2nd ed. 342. n.; K 42; Sem 75 f. Sta Geschichte.i.400 ). The גֵּר is to share in Sabbath rest Exod 20:10 ; 23:12 (both J E) Deut 5:14 ; otherwise he is have like obligations with Israel Exod 12:19 , 48 , 49 ; Lev 16:29 (all P) 17:8 , 10 , 12 , 13 , 15 ; 18:26 ; 20:2 ; 22:18 ; 24:16 , 22 (all H) Num 9:14 (twice in verse); 15:14-15 , (twice in verse); 15:16 , 26 , 29 , 30 ; 19:10 ; 35:15 (all P) Ezek 14:7 ; similar rights Deut 1:16 ; Ezek 47:22-23 , and like privileges Deut 16:11 , 14 ; 26:11 ; 29:10 ; 31:12 compare 2Chr 30:25 ; very rarely any distinction made, in obligation Lev 25:47 (3 t. in verse) (H), in permissible food Deut 14:21 ; in future success 28:43 ; kindness to גֵּר frequently enjoined: Lev 19:10 (|| עָנִי ), 23:22 (|| id. ) 19:34 (all H); Deut 10:18-19 , 14:29 ; 24:19-20 , 21 ; 26:12-13 , (all || וְאַלְמָנָה יָתוֺם ); oppression prohibited Lev 19:33 (H) Deut 24:14 ; Exod 22:20 ; 23:9 (twice in verse) (JE) Deut 24:17 ; 27:19 ; Jer 7:6 ; 22:3 ; Zech 7:10 (these eight || וְאַלְמָנָה יָתוֺם ); object of care to ׳י Psa 146:9 (|| id. ); charge that גֵּר has been oppressed Ezek 22:7 ; Mal 3:5 (both || id. ); also Ezek 22:29 (|| וְאֶבְיוֺן עָנִי ), Psa 94:6 ; compare also command that a poor brother be treated like גֵּר i.e. kindly, Lev 25:35 (H). Latest conception somewhat different: גֵּר 1Chr 22:2 ; 2Chr 2:16 ( הַגֵּירִים ) gathered for hard service; yet compare 30:25 . (Often with verbal cognate Exod 12:48-49 , Lev 16:29 ; 17:8 , 10 , 12 , 13 ; 18:26 ; 19:33 ; 20:2 ; Num 9:14 ; 15:14-15 , 16 , 26 , 29 ; 19:10 ; Josh 20:9 ; Ezek 47:22-23 , oft || תּוֺשָׁב Gen 23:4 ; Lev 25:23 , 35 , 47 ; 1Chr 29:15 ; Psa 39:13 ). [ גֵּיר ] noun masculine 2Chr 2:16 see גֵּר below I. גור .

In you have they treated father and mother with contempt.* Literally, made light of father and mother. Among you they have oppressed the foreigner. In you they have wronged the fatherless and the widow.
The people of the land have used oppression and exercised robbery. Yes, they have troubled the poor and needy, and have oppressed the foreigner wrongfully.

It will happen, that you shall divide it by lot for an inheritance to you and to the aliens who live among you, who will father children among you. Then they shall be to you as the native-born among the children of Israel. They shall have inheritance with you among the tribes of Israel.
It shall happen, that in whatever tribe the stranger lives, there you shall give him his inheritance,” says the Lord Yahweh.
Don’t oppress the widow, nor the fatherless, the foreigner, nor the poor; and let none of you devise evil against his brother in your heart.’

I will come near to you to judgment; and I will be a swift witness against the sorcerers, and against the adulterers, and against the perjurers, and against those who oppress the hireling in his wages, the widow, and the fatherless, and who deprive the foreigner of justice, and don’t fear me,” says Yahweh of Armies.
